articleTitle: UWB active antenna array for low frequency radio astronomy
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The decameter wavelength range is of interest for radio astronomy at the present time. Construction of giant low-frequency radio telescopes has been planned and is being carried out in European Union (Low Frequency Array - LOFAR), USA (Long Wavelength Array - LWA) and in Ukraine (Giant Ukrainian Radio Telescope - GURT). The radio telescope GURT, which is being created in the Institute of Radio Astronomy of NAS of Ukraine, will operate over frequency range from 10 to 70 MHz. The antenna system of telescope will be a phased antenna array consisting of many subarrays, each of 5×5 elements. The array element is an active crossed dipole with inclined arms. Phasing inside one section is performed with analog phase shifter. Output signals of the subarrays are transformed into digital form and are processed in DSP-receiver. In this paper the subarray of the GURT radio telescope is considered. The design, electric circuit and some results of experimental and theoretical researches are given and described.

articleTitle: Through-the-wall surveillance technologies
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: This paper will present a brief overview of methods for solving the problem of surveillance behind the opaque wall. A low cost method for detecting moving objects behind the wall, based on the analysis of reflected pulse UWB signal is considered in more details. Demonstration of real work of the method is carried out with use of the operating breadboard model of the device implementing this method.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of UWB impulse response of plane layered media with 2D inclusion
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the present paper one of possible approaches to the solution of a problem of modeling of propagation and diffraction UWB pulse signals on two-dimensional inclusions in plane-layered media is discussed. Key step consist of direct problem solution, which is based on the null-field method. As a result functional equations are reduced to a system of linear algebraic equations of the second kind, which allows the efficient numerical solution. Some practical results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Microwave propagation in specimens of foam materials located in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the summary the results of experimental research of the dielectric properties ε and tgδ, in microwave band 4.4 - 5.8 GHz foam specimens, which are located in sections of rectangular waveguides 48 × 24 mm are presented. The characteristics of reflection and absorption of electromagnetic waves of specimens were investigated.

articleTitle: Transient near field of Hertzian dipole
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: All components of near and far electromagnetic field radiated from Hertzian dipole excited by current with arbitrary time dependence are obtained in time domain by means of vector potential technique with the use of more precise approximation in the solution for near field. As an example, the problem of radiation of Herzian dipole with quickly decreasing excitation current from some constant value to zero is considered. The process of the forming of free electromagnetic field from quasi static field components in near zone of a dipole is discussed.

articleTitle: Wide-band reflection coefficient measurements using direct and inverse frequency-time domain transformations
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem of measurement of modulus of the reflection coefficient (RC) in wide frequency band in presence of additional reflections such as reflections in a horn antenna is considered. The Prony's method and the method of separation of autocorrelation function of layered structure by windowing in time domain for the restoration of the square modulus of the RC in wide frequency band were compared. The values of the error of restoration methods under consideration in the chosen frequency band have been calculated. It has been shown the advantage of the Prony's method application in sliding frame by the results of the numerical simulations and real measurement data processing. The technique of data extrapolation at the edges of the frequency band for applying Prony's method is proposed.

articleTitle: UWB pulse generators
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Techniques for generation of UWB pulses of subnanosecond duration by semiconductor devices are considered in the given work. Characteristics of step recovery diode (SRD) generators and serial pulse diode generators are investigated. The original circuit solutions increasing both the amplitude and the pulse repetition rate are presented. A generator circuit with symmetrical loading allowing to use this generator in the active antenna is proposed.

articleTitle: Antenna array with a given fractal distribution of current
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the paper the radiation patterns of equidistant, random and fractal antenna arrays were simulated and analyzed. We demonstrated efficiency of suppression of higher orders interference maxima due to fractal distribution of sources in the array as compared to their random distribution.

articleTitle: Deep subsurface radar sounding of rough extraterrestrial terrains: Numerical simulations
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem of subsurface radar sounding is considered. The side clutter produced by the roughness of both the diurnal surface and subsurface is accounted for. Numerical simulations are performed.

articleTitle: Dual-band circular-disk microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The dual-band circular-disk microstrip antenna is investigated. The possibility of main eigenwave of microstrip (the T-mode) transformation into surface mode theoretically is shown. The frequency bands of effective transformation experimentally are established. The counter lines of field structures are presented. The pattern characteristics are investigated.

articleTitle: Frequency range of Gunn diodes on base of graded-gap semiconductor nitrides
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper deals with the numerical simulation of Gunn diodes operation based on the graded-gap AlInN, GaInN and BInN. We had obtained the output characteristics of diodes with different cathode contacts in a wide range of frequencies. Harmonic and biharmonic modes of operation have been considered. Cutoff frequency and minimum length of the active region have been estimated. Performances of graded-gap AlInN, GaInN and BInN diodes are compared with the performances of InN, GaN and AlN diodes.

articleTitle: Properties of pulse surface waves in a dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Pulse signal propagation in an open circular dielectric waveguide was considered in Time Domain. The field partition into a guided wave, a radiated wave, and a pulse surface wave was observed. A precursor creation by the pulse surface wave in the dielectric waveguide is shown. In order to study long-time behavior of this wave a moving frame with BOR-FDTD method was used. A pure pulse wave can be excited by “moving” sources (consecutively exited along the waveguide) that was used for studying such wave structure by its own. Diffraction of this surface wave by a conical rod tip was simulated and analyzed as well.

articleTitle: Recognition of microwave multifrequency images of objects hidden behind wall
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The description of measuring equipment for radioimages obtaining on base of multufrequency data is presented. The algorithm of radioimage objects recognition using neural network technology was developed. The neural network architecture getting effective radioimage objects recognition under various conditions was found and recognition efficiency measures were calculated.

articleTitle: Radiation of UWB pulses by thin wire monopole
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Radiation and spatial - temporal dependencies of radiated electromagnetic pulses are investigated at excitation of thin wire monopole by UWB pulses. Principles of radiation patterns forming are discussed.

articleTitle: Time-varying wiener filtering based on short-time fourier transform
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper considers filtering noisy pulse signals using Wiener filtering technique applied in the Short Time Fourier Transform domain. It is assumed that there exists some a priori estimation of the signal spectrum within some time interval for each moment, such estimation may be available when the signal consists of some transients repeated in quasi-periodical manner, or when there exists some concurrent much less noisy process that can be used to estimate the momentary spectrum of the filtered signal. Efficiency of the proposed technique is demonstrated on filtering noisy magnetocardiographic signals based on concurrent electrocardiograms. Its superiority over stationary Wiener filtering is shown.

articleTitle: Wavelet UWB signal processing for underground sounding systems
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A method for solving problems of digital signal processing of video pulse ground penetrating radar (GPR) data based on a generalized approach is proposed. The effective procedure of removing the trend from a GPR signal is synthesized on the basis of Kravchenko-Gauss wavelets. The noise level caused by edge effects is minimized in this procedure. The estimation stability of radio contrasts of images of subsurface layers at the abnormal interference emission is achieved by the signal processing algorithm based on the double median filtering and optimal weighting with the Kravchenko-Hamming window. A further development of methods of similar signal preprocessing is discussed in the paper.

articleTitle: Mode expansions in time domain
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper considers some methods of modeling transient electromagnetic phenomena in regular along some dimension structures (waveguides) that are based on exploiting field decomposition into series of “modes”. In case of transverse inhomogeneous dielectric filling of the waveguide the known in frequency domain modes become dependent on frequency that makes it impossible to transfer them into the time domain as is. A time domain formulation in terms of coupled frequency independent modes is proposed and the optimal choice of the modes for expanding the fields is justified based on operator formulation.

articleTitle: Simulation methods for penetration of electric fields inside structurally irregular conductive screens
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Structural irregularities have a major impact on the protective properties of conductive screens. This paper addresses the methods for simulating the penetration of electric fields inside real 3-dimensional structurally irregular electromagnetic screens in quasi-statics. The author aims to find the reference method for the future theoretical as well as experimental studies on real conductive screens. Simulating an infinite thin conductive plate with a circular orifice provides both qualitative and quantitative characteristics of the selected numerical method.

articleTitle: Sampling pulse width versus forward current in the step recovery diode
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The short pulse generator for shaping sampling pulses, which width can be changed by the forward current in the step recovery diode (SRD), is investigated in the present work. Dependences of sampling pulse width and amplitude on current in SRD are given in the paper.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis of model fractal ultra-wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The fractal ultra-wideband (FUWB) signals as a modern type of the ultra-wideband (UWB) signals for application in different branches of science and engineering in particular for near-to-Earth space investigations are considered. The set of analytical and numerical FUWB signal models are discussed. Different types of wavelet analysis is proposed to the FUWB signal investigations. Some examples of application the continuous wavelet transform and the analytical wavelet transform to the analysis of the FUWB signal models are shown.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of the dependence of transmitter power and antenna efficiency at a deep GPR studies
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper we experimentally investigate the structure of the field on the surface of the cut for different transmitter power, united by one constructive solution. The obtained dependences of the field from the transmitter power, pulse duration and repetition rate in comparison with the calculated data allow us to determine the optimum configuration and sounding of GPR data.

articleTitle: Energy and polarization characteristics of X-slots in the waveguide with a dielectric heterogeneity and complex load
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The possibilities of control of polarization and energy characteristics of the X-slots cut in the broad wall of rectangular waveguide with a complex load at the end and with the dielectric heterogeneity of the input waveguide section with a slot investigated. Numerical and experimental investigation of energy and polarization characteristics of such systems are performed. Changing the parameters: the dielectric heterogeneity, position its relative the slot and changing complex load allow to adjust X-radiation field with circular polarization, with a high emissivity and low VSWR at the input.

articleTitle: Energy parameters and directional characteristics of a finite system of transverse slots in rectangular waveguide with the dielectric layer
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Energetic and directional characteristics of an antenna array (AA) with transversal slots cut in a rectangular waveguide, partially filled with dielectric are investigated. A dielectric layer is parallel to broad walls of the waveguide. It was shown the possibility implementation of wide-angle scanning antenna based on waveguide-slot antenna with slowing down a wave in the waveguide on the effective radiation.

articleTitle: Direction and range characteristics of rarefied antenna arrays with screens
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The numerical analysis of the characteristics of rarefied arrays of weakly directed radiators, located at an arbitrary height above a screen, is given. It is shown that certain array parameters lead to the maximum maximorum directivity, and that this is significantly higher than the gain factor of classical antenna arrays. The optimal distance between radiators increases with the height of the array over the screen.

articleTitle: About influence of mutual coupling on pattern and wave form of pulse reradiated by Van Atta's array of tapered slot antennas
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A model for calculation of waveform and peak power pattern of Van Atta's array of tapered slot antennas (TSA) which reradiates wideband video-pulse signal has been presented. An influence of mutual coupling of elements of Van Atta's array on pattern has been shown. An effect of different types of polarities of connecting wires on a wave form of reradiated signal has been investigated.

articleTitle: Frequency domain equalization of MSK for UAV data link
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper, confronting the frequency-selective fading in the channel of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), the technology of single-carrier frequency domain equalization (SCFDE) which can resist to the frequency selective fading is discussed for minimum shift keying (MSK). And then, a channel model is discussed for UAV and the composition of the UAV communication channel is analyzed. What's more, the impulse response model of the channel is given similar to the Rice channel. In the end, simulation of SCFDE in the channel model under three scenarios shows that SCFDE is an effective approach resistance to the frequency selective fading.

articleTitle: Effects of tem-horn antenna tapering
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Pulse radiation of TEM horn antennas with different tapering profiles was simulated and the effects of tapering on the near fields, radiated fields, and the return losses are discussed. Some considerations about the ways to improve TEM horn characteristics are presented.

articleTitle: Modelling of the field distribution of the periodically nonuniform structures by the branched continued fraction
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper the results of development of the mathematical models of structures, which are modulated by pulse sequences multiple periodic functions are represent and the features of the electromagnetic field forming by such structures, namely the dielectric plate with complex laws of modulation of dielectric permittivity and the modulated circular cylinder, are tested.

articleTitle: System spectral analysis of model ultra-wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The theoretical basis and practical peculiarities of a new integrated signal analysis method called as the system spectral analysis are considered. Using the simple analytical models of ultra-wideband signals in time domain, the possibilities, advantages and disadvantages of the system spectral analysis are described. The necessity and the expediency of simultaneously application of different linear and non-linear integral transforms during the system spectral analysis performance are explained. The system spectral analysis usage for the ultra-wideband signal time-frequency structure investigation is shown to be effective and useful.

articleTitle: A broadband printed dipole and a printed array for radar application
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A printed dipole without balun is presented, featuring a broadband performance and simple for manufacture process. As an estimating design, an antenna array is designed and simulated for X-range radar application.

articleTitle: Wavelet analysis of multi-fractal ultra-wideband processes in problems of geospace physics
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The wavelet analysis to the fractal ultra-wideband (UWB) processes in the geospace physics is proposed to apply. The continuous wavelet transform and the analytical wavelet transform for the investigation of magnetic Dst-index time series are used. The structure of wavelet spectrum and skeleton is obtained to be fractal. With usage of the wavelet transform module maxima (WTMM) method the multi-fractal properties of the investigated fractal UWB (FUWB) process is discovered and the corresponding fractal dimensions is estimated.

articleTitle: Diffraction of UWB EM pulse waves by layered dispersive structure
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: An analysis of results of FDTD-simulation of UWB electromagnetic pulse wave diffraction by a layered dispersive structure like soil is presented in this work. The radar images of this structure obtained at different spatial locations of the antenna system for various dielectric parameters of layers are constructed and analyzed in the paper. The amplitude-time characteristics of reflected pulses are analyzed too.

articleTitle: Impulse response of the metal-semiconductor-metal photodetector
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Impulse response of the metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) detectors is analyzed. Effect of optical excitation level on the MSM-photodetector performance is discussed. At low excitation level the detector speed of response is limited by parasitic capacitance of interdigitated diode structure and by the transit time of the photogene-rated carriers. At high excitation levels the detector speed of response is degraded due to the internal field screening caused by the space-charge of the holes.

articleTitle: Research of combined helical antenna characteristics for MIMO-technology
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The combined helical antenna with the counter winding of turns for MIMO-technology is offered in the paper. The feature of this antenna is possibility of radiation and reception of electromagnetic waves with a random polarization structure. This property of antenna allows decreasing the level of fading conditioned by the polarization effects at multibeam propagating of electromagnetic waves in the urban and/or organizing independent or weakly dependent channels of reception/ transmission that is topically for realization of MIMO-technology. For the modeling of the characteristics of the combined helical antenna in the transmission mode and the receive mode the generalized induced EMF-method is used. The modeling results are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: Research of radiation characteristics of antennas with logarithmic periodicity
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The method of choice geometrical parameters of the band antenna in the form of plane structure with trapezoidal overhangs is offered. Results of numerical calculations directivity pattern in E and H the planes in the given frequency range are provided.

articleTitle: Calculation of fisher information matrix and its application in methods of recognition and classification for remote sensing of earth
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The application of Fisher information matrix in methods of recognition and classification for remote sensing of Earth is considered. The determination and calculation algorithm of Fisher information matrix for the case of independent observed objects of probability learning sample are presented. It is shown the use of the Fisher information matrix in statistical theory for the estimation of precision of a recognition and classification, namely, Fisher information matrix is applied for the calculation of mean square errors of lower confidence bound in Bayesian probability, of classification quality criterion of probability learning sample, and for construction of optimal method of pattern classification on such factors as “set of object characteristics” and “classification rule”. The optimization of the method is carried out on continuous optimization trajectory on the hyperplane of two factors “set of object characteristics” and “classification rule”. The ways of improvement of the presented approach are proposed.

articleTitle: Resonant length of electric dipole located inside dihedral corner reflector
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: For an electric dipole length 2l located in the bisector plane of a thin perfectly conducting corner reflector with infinite side sizes both the RS and X parts of the input impedance and the dipole resonant length at X = 0 as functions of the dipole-to-corner distance S at different flare angles were calculated via the method of images and induced electromotive forces. It is shown that with varying S the dipole resonant length is decreasing as well as increasing with respect to the half wave. Effect is more noticeable than have less a flare angle and bigger the thickness of a dipole.

articleTitle: Effect of random errors of reflector profile on characteristics of single-reflector antenna
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The effect of the random errors of a reflector profile on the directional pattern and directive gain of a single-reflector antenna has been researched into by the method of physical optics.

articleTitle: Rigorous calculation of ultra short pulse propagation in a shielded microstrip line using coupled mode expansion in time domain
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A new time domain method for effective calculation of transient electromagnetic fields in a shielded quasi TEM transmission line is proposed. The method is based on presenting the fields in time domain as expansions over some coupled frequency independent modes. It was shown that just several coupled modes are enough to account for in order to calculate a band limited signal propagation in the structure with high accuracy. The method is demonstrated on example of impulse wave excitation and propagation in a shielded microstrip line. The mode functions are calculated using finite element method for the elliptic type boundary eigenvalue problem, while hyperbolic evolutionary equation for the mode amplitudes is solved using method of finite differences in time domain. The conditions of distortionless propagation in a quasi-TEM line are found and explained.

articleTitle: Using embedded semi-Markov processes for describing nonstationary signals and fields
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The possibility of using embedded semi-Markov processes for creating statistical models of signals reflected from the interface (land-sea) as well as from areas of the “clear” sky is considered in the given work. And parameters of these areas are identified on the basis of experimental data. It is shown that the nonstationarity of seasonal changes in the troposphere refractive index can be accounted for by describing its statistics by poly-Gaussian models. Model parameters for each season are derived experimentally. The proposed approach can be used to create a simulation model of the refractive index behavior using embedded semi-Markov processes.

articleTitle: Radiation from the transverse slot cut in a coaxial line in the lossy material medium
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Radiation in the material medium from the transverse slot cut in the screen of the coaxial line has been studied by the magnetomotive forces method theoretically. Internal and external conductivities of the arc and circumferential slots, radiating into the space filled by an imperfect dielectric with tg δ ≤ 1, have been investigated. The radiation and reflection coefficients of the transverse slot in the coaxial line have been studied in the broad band of wavelength.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic waves excitation by vibrator-slot structure in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A problem of electromagnetic waves excitation by a structure, consisting of a narrow transverse slot in a broad wall of a rectangular waveguide and a vibrator with variable surface impedance, located inside the waveguide, is solved by the generalized method of induced electro-magneto-motive forces. Conditions, necessary for achievement of maximal slot radiation coefficient are defined. Calculated and experimental plots of energy characteristics of the vibrator-slot structure for different vibrator placement relative to the slot and for various dependencies of surface impedance upon the vibrator length are presented.

articleTitle: Structure and radiophysical properties of ferrite-based materials, designed for ultrawideband systems
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper presents some results of studies of radioabsorbing materials of meter and decimeter wavelength range on the basis of ferrites, as well as composite materials based on them. Some technology aspects of modified ferrites are given in account; the techniques of the determinations dispersion of the material parameters (complex permittivity and permeability) are discussed. Example of complex permeability of Ni-Zn, Mg-Zn ferrites in a frequency range from 1 MHz up to 8 GHz and electron microscopy investigations are presented.

articleTitle: Waves diffraction in coaxial waveguide with slots in the inner conductor
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The operator method is used for the analysis of a system of annular slots in the hollow inner conductor of a coaxial waveguide. The possibility of waveguides filling with dielectric discs is taken into consideration. The operator equations for bounded and semiinfinite periodic sequence of slots are presented. Dependencies of the elements of scattering matrix of the TEM- and TE11- modes as functions of wavenumber are analyzed. The possibility of application of such structures as wide-band and narrow-band filters is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimization of geometrical parameters of a spherical reflector with the allowed phase errors in the aperture
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The analysis of the phase error in the aperture of the spherical reflector, due to a deviation from the spherical surface of a parabolic, as well as the displacement of the feed point of focus is presented. Derived the formulas for evaluating the permissible phase error.

articleTitle: The accuracy in potential of establishing the position of ground based objects by the matrix radiometer systems of remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The analytical expressions for the dispersion in estimating dispersion of the potential precision in coordinate determining of complex shape ground based objects both area and extended are obtained via the matrix radiometer systems of remote sensing. Quantitative evaluation evidences establishing with the required accuracy the position of area ground object as a set of rectangles with the matrix radiometer systems of millimeter band, e.g. of an object like a take-off and landing strip.

articleTitle: Anomalous wideband absorption in ultrathin copper wires
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The effect of anomalous absorption in thin wires consists in the fact that the absorption cross-section of a cylinder can exceed the geometric cross-section by 3-5 orders of magnitude. This effect is extremely wideband. In the paper it is demonstrated on example of copper wires of nanometer-micrometer scale. Drude model of dispersion for the copper was used in the calculation, the resulting absorption cross section dependence on wavelength and wire diameter is fitted with a simple closed-form formula. The effect is analyzed from the time domain point of view and its possible applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Generation of spatial-temporal airy pulses
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Generation of pulses by a given source is considered in paraxial approximation. It is shown that well-known Gaussian pulses as well as more exotic Airy pulses can be generated by an appropriate current. All these results are obtained by virtue of the Green's function, which is derived in paraxial approximation. Peculiarities of Airy pulses in comparison with Gaussian ones are considered.

articleTitle: Scattering and generation of wawes by cubically polarisable layered media under the influence of weak fields
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: We consider the effects of weak fields at multiple frequencies on the scattering and generation of waves by an isotropic, nonmagnetic, linearly E-polarised, layered, cubically polarisable, dielectric structure. In the domain of resonance frequencies we consider wave packets consisting of both strong electromagnetic fields at the excitation frequency of the nonlinear structure, leading to the generation of waves, and of weak fields at the multiple frequencies, which do not lead to the generation of harmonics but influence on the process of scattering and generation of waves.

articleTitle: Excitation of pulse magnetic flux inside a magnetodielectric cylinder
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem of diffraction of the electromagnetic pulse with Gaussian envelope inside the infinite isotropic magnetodielectric circular cylinder with complex permeability is considered. The influence of electrodynamic parameters of the cylinder on the amplitude-to-time dependence of magnetic flux, induced inside the cylinder, is analyzed.

articleTitle: Numerical methods of calculation transformation matrixes at designing nonsingular invisibility cloak-carpet
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: At present work use nonsingular invisibility cloak as carpet is offered. Possibility completely the numerical approach to calculation nonsingular invisibility cloak of arbitrary shape is shown. Numerical simulation of invisibility carpet with arbitrary shapes is lead.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband MIMO radars. The basic principles of theory and design
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The theory basics and formation principles of a new class of UWB radars with inertia- free scanning of space for radar observation of aerial targets are considered. The basis for such radars is an application of coherent orthogonal sounding signals (SS), emitted by spaced antenna array (AA) elements. The receiving of echo-signals may be implemented by single antenna (SA) with space-time signal processing on its output on the basis of aperture synthesis (use of the receiving AA is probable but not a fundamental factor).

articleTitle: Impulse antennas of ultra-short impulse electronic systems
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The objective of this paper is to describe specific properties of transmitting and receiving impulse antennas that distinguish them from conventional antennas. It demonstrates the impact of impulse antenna matching, dimensions, configuration and Joule losses upon the quality of ultra-short drive pulse conversion to electromagnetic ultra-short pulses and vice versa. General recommendations are given with regard to impulse antenna design.

articleTitle: Variants of construction the mobile wideband communication channel Wi-Fi - 3G
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Variants of mobile broadband communication channels Wi-Fi - 3G based on application of small carriers are studied. Previously unknown experimental properties of these channels are given and empirically demonstrated the feasibility of their application in practice.

articleTitle: The modeling of ultra-wideband signals and processes
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Most of existing ultra-wideband (UWB) signal models were collected together, analyzed and classified. For the describing of UWB signal models the set of numerical characteristics were proposed and successfully used. Those characteristics on the generalized plane method and on the instantaneous spectrum method are based. The characteristics set was shown to be effective and useful at the samples of analysis of two UWB signal models based on the Laguerre and fractal correspondingly.

articleTitle: Ultrawideband planar antennas and antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper presents analysis of signals and planar monopole pulse antennas and antenna arrays designed for work in ultrawideband (UWB) frequency band 3.1-10.6GHz. A complex approach to design, synthesis and optimization of UWB antennas is proposed. Frequency and time characteristics of UWB signals, designed single and two-element antennas, results of experimental investigations and radiation of UWB signals by the antennas and antenna arrays are presented in the paper.

Author Keywords: planar UWB antennas and antenna arrays

articleTitle: Effects of ultra-wideband radiation on viability of human cells
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Effects of ultra-wideband radiation (UWBR) on isolated cells of human buccal epithelium are presented. Cells were isolated from human organism before experiment and suspension of cells was exposed during 10 seconds to UWBR of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> - 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> intensity. In different periods after exposure to UWBR cells were stained with fluorescent stains Hoechst 3342 and ethidium bromide in purpose to assess their viability. The percentage of damaged cells was assessed by the standard criterion - the percentage of cells with nuclei stained red of pink by ethidium bromide. Cell exposure to UWBR of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> - 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> results in increase of percentage of damaged cells. The percentage of damaged cells gradually decreases up to 3 hours after cell exposure. This phenomenon is interpreted as cell recovery after cell damage induced by UWBR. The data obtained are discussed in connection to the experimental results on UWBR upon cell nucleus structure obtained previously.

articleTitle: Interaction of electromagnetic pulses of different temporal dependences with a dispersive layer (model of human body)
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The results of the plane electromagnetic pulse propagation through the dielectric layer with the human skin parameters are considered in this paper. The problem is solved for arbitrary temporal form of the incident signal. Pulses with different temporal forms (for example, a Gauss pulse, Gaussian monopulse) were chosen for comparison the results of interaction. The energy characteristics and temperature changing for different incident pulses are investigated.

articleTitle: Energy balance equations and reciprocity relations for two-dimensionally periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Analytical results that describe important properties of electromagnetic waves propagating in the reflection and transmission zones of two-dimensionally periodic structures are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Plasma antenna on subrezonant UHF discharge
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The short low-frequency plasma antenna based on UHF discharge in inert gases is presented. On the critic parameters the interaction of ion-acoustic waves and plasma waves in UHF discharge leads to transfer of power spectrum in the low frequencies.

articleTitle: Performance of a multisectional Tesla transformer
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The performance and details of design are discussed for impulse Tesla transformers with various numbers of primaries. Possible ways of parameter optimization are suggested.

articleTitle: Numerical synthesis of cylindrical arrays
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The authors propose a synthesis method for cylindrical arrays. This method allows the calculation of the required amplitude-phase distribution within a given active sector of the antenna array, taking into account the directional properties of the radiating elements.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional antenna with a radiation field of circular polarization
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In the paper the results of development of the non-directional antenna with circular polarization of a radiation field are presented. Authors introduce a new method of formation of circular polarization at the circular radiation pattern (RP) in an azimuthal plane.

articleTitle: Compact broadband microstrip radiators with capacitive coaxial feeder
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: We consider three models of compact wideband microstrip antennas (MSA) with radome to operate in the frequency range 1.2 to 1.65 GHz. They are characterized by different forms of ring-radiating patch and a weak capacitive coupling with the feeder microstrip line. Each antenna has a suspended substrate FR4 with radiator patch and feed strip and a lower substrate FR4 with the microstrip line and broadband transition from the microstrip line to the feeder strip.

articleTitle: Bispinor and logical reconstruction of a mathematic-physical model to express a dynamic electromagnetic field excited by varying current
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Bispinor is a differential operator endowed with objective connotation and lots of particular characters, and thus becomes a key and unavoidable concept in electromagnetic theory. This paper points out that it is impossible or even purely self-deceptive for us to suppose forms of gauges in order to replace bispinor with other mathematical forms. Based upon a rather systematic analysis of bispinor, a fresh formula about its properly posed boundary value problem is supplied. Then, a properly posed boundary problem or an exact mathematic-physical model for a dynamic electromagnetic field excited by a varying current is reconstructed.

articleTitle: Plasma antenna with mercury filling used for aerospace vehicles
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Results of account the effect of mercury vapor on the specific conductivity and relative permittivity of the plasma antenna are shown. The influence of mercury vapor on the efficiency of the plasma antenna is described.

Author Keywords: conductivity and relative permeability of plasma

articleTitle: Linear array of loop antennas with series excitation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: We have considered a linear array, in which the radiators are loop antennas of a rhombic form. In the array, a central pair of loop antennas is excited from a power cable. The other loop antennas are exited from each other. We have researched numerically, by the method of moments, into the dependences of the key parameters of an antenna on the number of loops in the array. The array characteristics have been compared with the characteristics of a Yagi-Uda antenna.

articleTitle: Beamforming network for eight-element antenna array
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The beamforming network for eight-element antenna array synthesised on the basis of Butler matrix is offered in this paper. The new network contains smaller quantity of crossings in comparison with Butler's matrix. The comparative analysis of the basic characteristics of a Butler matrix and the offered network in a frequency band 9-11 GHz has been carried out by means of numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Wigner analysis in problem of ultra-wideband signal detection with noise presents
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The Wigner transform well known as the square time-frequency transform from Cohen's class for solving of problem of the ultra-wideband signal detection with presents of additive weakly correlated noise with non-Gaussian distribution was proposed. The general properties, advantages and disadvantages of the Wigner transform were discussed. Using proposed detection algorithm based on the Wigner analysis, for some simple models of ultra-wideband signals in time domain the problem of ultra- wideband signal detection with presents of noise with uniform distribution was solved. The results obtained and the algorithm peculiarities were discussed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field in a dispersive medium filled cavity under pulse train excitation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Electromagnetic field in a cavity filled with temporary dispersive homogeneous isotropic medium is excited by a train of wideband current pulses. The solution is obtained in the time domain. Several frequency dependences of permittivity and permeability are considered. Peculiarities of choosing the pulse train parameters for cavity excitation in different cases are discussed.

articleTitle: Broadband antenna with operated polarization of radiation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The new construction variant of the broadband antenna with operated field polarization on a basis three-branch conical spiral antenna is offered and realised. Results of mathematical modelling are considered, optimum geometrical parametres of radiators are chosen.

articleTitle: Wideband electromagnetic scattering by objects with radioabsorbing coating
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The calculation method for modeling of plane electromagnetic wave scattering by a perfectly conducting electrically large object wholly or partly covered by radio absorbing coating. The object admits surface breaks with toroidal absorbing coating. This method is based on the calculation of contributions to scattering field by smooth surface parts (physical optics approximation) and local break scattering parts (original asymptotical method). The method is used for calculation of cruise missile radar cross-section (RCS) and transient responses.

articleTitle: Influence of mutual coupling between two dipoles on their resonant length in metal screen presence
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: On the base of the induced electromotive forces method with using the uniform geometrical theory of diffraction fast algorithms and codes for calculating the input impedance and the resonant length of two connected in phase electric dipoles placed above a thin metal rectangular screen at parallel orientation to it and an arbitrary locating of the dipoles from each other are developed. From analysis follows that the shortening of the resonant dipole length is bigger than for two parallel dipoles in free space but is smaller than the length shortening of single dipole above the screen.

articleTitle: Effect of width of elementary radiator radiation pattern to cylindrical antenna array performance
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper presents the results of investigations of the influence of the radiation pattern (RP) width of an elementary radiator (ER) on the characteristics of a cylindrical antenna array (CAA). The recommendations are given for the choice of the parameters of amplitude distribution (AD) and the width of the ER RP in which the CAA has the best electrical characteristics.

articleTitle: Modeling of random UWB signals and its characteristics in information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Discrete representation of random ultra wideband (UWB) signals based on wavelet basis and its characteristics determination method are suggested. Conditions for uniform convergence in probability on [0,T] of wavelet expansions for random process X={X(t),t ∈ R]} are discussed. Suggest stochastic model may be used in design process of information systems.

articleTitle: Noise immunity of broadband digital communication channels with adaptive antennas and M-phase signal modulation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The influence of random changes in the direction of interference arrival on the interference immunity of broadband communication channel with adaptive antennas has been investigated. The dependence of the probability of bit error in the communication channel when the difference between the directions of the arrival of the desired signal and interference has been shown. The sector of reliable signal reception at different distances between the elements of the antenna array has been defined.

articleTitle: Development of GPR “GROT” series
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper discusses new developments in the product line of GPR “GROT” series: GROT12 and GROT12E. The basic advantages and opportunities for GPR.

articleTitle: Application of generalized Kravchenko-Kotelnikov-Levitan sampling theorems for signal filtration
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this report the new designs of digital filters constructed on the basis of the atomic functions (AF) are offered. They are possessing good time-and-frequency properties and also fast convergence. Efficiency of the offered Low- and High- frequency filters is investigated on an example of digital signal processing with reference to problems of an interferometry and synthesis in radio astronomy.

articleTitle: Inverse scattering problem in diagnostics of multilayer periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The dual regularization method is applied in the inverse problem of electromagnetic scattering to retrieve permittivity inhomogeneities in multilayer periodic dielectric structures. Based on the developed theory, the solution algorithm has been worked out and applied in the numerical simulation of the multifrequency reflectometry diagnostics of inhomogeneities in multilayer structures of X-ray optics.

articleTitle: Modeling of random UWB signals and its characteristics in information systems
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Discrete representation of random ultra wideband (UWB) signals based on wavelet basis and its characteristics determination method are suggested. Conditions for uniform convergence in probability on [0,T] of wavelet expansions for random process X={X(t),t ∈ R]} are discussed. Suggest stochastic model may be used in design process of information systems.

articleTitle: Recent advances in SAR technique
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A review is given on SAR data processing techniques recently developed at the Institute of Radio Astronomy of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine. The proposed methods are intended to improve quality and legibility of SAR images obtained with airborne SAR systems. An original method for the estimation of the antenna beam orientation from Doppler measurements and an effective local-quadratic map-drift autofocus (LQMDA) are developed to support the GPS-based SAR navigation system in the task of the motion error compensation. The achieved high phase accuracy allows the application of the multi-look SAR processing technique for suppressing speckle noise and revealing fine details in SAR images. A technique of 3D-imaging of ground surface with a conventional single-antenna, squint-mode SAR has also been proposed. The efficiency of these solutions has been confirmed with Ku and X-band SAR systems.

articleTitle: Wearable microwave autodyne sensor for monitoring of heart rhythm and breath
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: A design of microwave autodyne heart rhythm and breath sensor is discussed in the paper. Principles of sensor design, based on the Doppler's effect, are shown. It was shown the use of autodyne ensures excellent performance of the sensor. The sensor construction possesses extreme simplicity. Conventional patch antenna conforms to the microwave sensor design ideally.

articleTitle: A review of ultrawideband antennas
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Summary form only given. Conventionally, the design of antennas is narrowband and little attention is paid to the phase responses of the devices as functions of frequency. Even the use of the term broadband is misleading as one essentially takes a narrow band signal and sweeps it across the band of interest. In fact, it is not necessary to pay too much attention to the phase for narrowband signals, as the role played by the frequency factor is that of a scalar multiplier. However, if one now wants to use multiple frequencies and attempts to relate the data obtained at each frequency, then this frequency term can no longer be ignored. Depending on the application, this scale factor can actually have significant variations, which also depend on the size and the shape of the bandwidth over which the performance of the system is observed. In the time domain, the effect of this frequency term creates havoc as it provides a highly nonlinear operation and hence must be studied carefully. By broadband we mean temporal signals with good signal integrity. When it comes to waveform diversity, which implicitly assumes time-dependent phenomena, it is not possible to do any meaningful system design unless the effects of the antennas are taken into account. These effects will be illustrated in terms of the responses of the antennas and on the applicability of the current popular methodology of time reversal for the vector electromagnetic problem. Some fundamental problems in studying concepts involving the responses of antennas in the time domain are related to our subconscious definition of reciprocity. In the frequency domain, reciprocity is related simply to the fact that the spatial response of the sensor in the transmit mode is EQUAL to the spatial response of the sensor in the receive mode at any frequency of interest. In the time domain, the spatial response of the sensor will be time dependent. Hence, both the transmit and the receive impulse responses of the sensor will be a function of azimuth and elevation angles. However, for a fixed spatial angle, the transmit impulse response is NOT EQUAL to the receive impulse response of ANY sensor. In fact, mathematically one can argue that the transmit impulse response is the time derivative of the receive impulse response for any sensor. One may then conclude that somehow reciprocity is violated through this principle. The important fact is that the product in the frequency domain results in a convolution in the time domain and that the reciprocity relationship is no longer a simple one. Even though the transmit impulse response is the time derivative of the receive impulse response, reciprocity still holds! The above principle now helps us in characterizing different sensors for different applications as their temporal responses are quite different. For illustration, an experimental demonstration of a 40 GHz wide bandwidth system will be described. Also, a transient pulse meeting the FCC guideline will also be illustrated.

articleTitle: Radar equation for ultra-wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The most general form of radar equation for ultra-wideband signals usage was obtained. The possibility of the electromagnetic missile effect appearance during the remote radio sounding of different media and objects with ultra-wideband signal usage was taken into account. The quantitative criterion describing that possibility was proposed. The radar equation for ultra-wideband signals usage, got in this paper, with less general ones obtained by other authors was compared. The conditions of existence of limiting process from the most general form of radar equation to the other ones were written. The radar equation for ultra-wideband signals usage in methods of remote radio sounding of the near-to-Earth and cosmic media was modified.

articleTitle: Method of natural frequency estimation for uwb signal and its use for analysis of quasi-resonance effects
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The method of determining the single oscillation frequency has been proposed. This method is effective at short duration of time-domain signal and at high noise level. The method has been used to analyze the quasi-resonance effect in the open resonance structure formed by the plane-parallel mirrors.

articleTitle: Vacuum Microwave Integrated Circuits as a tool for protection of radar and communication receivers against high power EMI radiation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Vacuum Microwave Integrated Circuits (VMIC) is suggested for design of radar front-end to provide high resistance against ionizing radiation and high power electromagnetic impulse radiations. We describe general approach to the suggested VMIC design and give preliminary results of its possible implementation and future applications.

articleTitle: Building of general algorithm of solving problems of radiation from a longitudinal slot in the wide wall of rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The construction of general algorithm of decision of radiation from a longitudinal slot in the wide wall of rectangular waveguide is considered. An algorithm is created on the basis of integral theorem of vectorial theory of diffraction. In this algorithm the tensor Green's function is used.

articleTitle: Method for determining the information redundancy of radio communication channel with wideband signals
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: In this paper it is suggested to use numerical methods of minimax to formalize modeling minimax strategy algorithm, in calculation of information redundancy of radio channels with wideband signals, when energy characteristics of radio channels are determined by a priori operators of forecast estimation functions of power of wideband signals as ratio signal/noise at input-output.

articleTitle: Logic improprieties implied in classical electromagnetism & some unsolved propositions
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Adhering only to logic consistency principle, this paper first makes a systematical logic examination and arrangement over the classical electromagnetism created by Maxwell, pointing out that Maxwell's equations cannot directly construct a proper boundary value problem and have many logic improprieties or inconsistency implied in the old theorem.

articleTitle: Optimization of the radiation pattern of regular antenna arrays with taking into account mutual coupling between radiators
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The problem of radiation pattern optimization of regular antenna arrays with the use of the point objective function with taking into account interaction of the radiators in the outer space has been considered. The procedure of including of impedances of radiators into the scheme of optimization in order to obtain suitable voltages of excitation of radiators has been described. The comparison of the results of radiation pattern optimization of the antenna arrays without taking into account mutual influence of radiators and at the direct including of the matrix of the mutual resistances into the procedure of optimization has been made. The examples of the optimized radiation patterns and the voltages of excitation for antenna arrays, consisting of parallel half-wave vibrators, are given. The comparison of the obtained optimal radiation pattern with results of modeling of the antenna arrays with the calculated complex voltages of excitation of the vibrators by the method of moments in the program MMANA-GAL has been made.

articleTitle: High power broadband stripline radiator
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The structure of a stripline radiator with an air substrate and a bandwidth of 17% by a matching criterion has been described. The results of the numerical simulation accomplished using the Microwave Office program have been presented.

articleTitle: Calculation method of radiation multi-band antennas in the far field
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: This paper introduces a method of determining the geometry of the multiband antenna, and developed an algorithm for determining the currents on its surface. Shown feasibility of further calculation of the radiation field.

articleTitle: Optimizing a hira system for high voltage, UWB operation
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The paper describes several versions of the `half-reflector' impulse radiating antenna, intended for operation with high voltage sources, such as to provide electric field intensities about 70 kV/m at distances r >; 20 m away from the aperture. The TEM horn feed of the antenna consists of cylindrical conductors (metal pipes), which geometry ensures a better stability against electric breakdown. The design of the feed arms and the TEM horn as a whole is optimized, via numerical simulation of the system's performance, for higher values of the radiated E-field, lower level of reflections throughout the feed line, and safe operation at very high voltages.

articleTitle: Using integral equation method for finewire objects to calculate characteristics of microstrip antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: The article states microstrip radiator arrays modeling results using the integral equation method for fine-wire objects. Effective dielectric capacitivity was introduced into Poklington Integral Equation to account for the effect of insulating base. Modeling results were then compared with published data and data obtained using modern electrodynamic modeling software.

articleTitle: It is invented! Now what?
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: Many technical discoveries or inventions begin and end their existence in a university laboratory. Aware of this, both professors and students have asked perceptive questions about how to move their work from the laboratory to the marketplace. This paper provides introductory suggestions to some of the questions most commonly asked at UWBUSIS meetings over the past six years. Both suggestions about positive approaches to movement of their work and approaches to avoid are included. The paper concludes with a series of examples intended to illustrate the general concepts that explain successful behaviors in the marketplace.

articleTitle: Memories of Prof. Carl E. Baum
publicationTitle: 2012 6th International Conference on Ultrawideband and Ultrashort Impulse Signals
abstract: It is entirely right and proper to share memories of Dr. Carl Baum. Capturing who he was and how he contributed provides those of us who remain with visible goals and aspirations for our own behaviors and endeavors. Dr. Baum received a multitude of symbols and tokens for his achievements as a scientist. I have the good fortune to remember him in modestly different contexts that perhaps help us to understand better the whole man.
